name: io.github.TMHSDigital/steam-mcp
title: Steam MCP Server
description: Steam Web API tools: store data, player counts, reviews, prices, Workshop, leaderboards, sales.

environmentVariables.name: STEAM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Steam Web API key. Optional: the store and asset tools work without one. Publisher tools need a publisher key.

environmentVariables.name: STEAM_FINANCIAL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Financial API Group key for the sales tools. Falls back to STEAM_API_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: STEAM_MCP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to load (store, community, publisher, mutations, sdk, assets) or all.
